annotations.title: WhatsApp Sandbox (try before a WhatsApp account)

description: Try WhatsApp before owning a WhatsApp Business Account: how to use Twilio's WhatsApp Sandbox on the brand's own Twilio account (testers send join <code> to +1 415 523 8886, joins last 3 days), the webhook URL that puts their messages in the Inbox, and the limits. Replies go out with send_sms channel "whatsapp_sandbox". Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
